name: @pipeworx/mcp-china-tax-policy

tools.name: cn_tax_policy_search
tools.description: Search the State Taxation Administration (国家税务总局) policy library of Chinese tax laws, departmental rules, normative documents and MOF/STA joint announcements (财政部 税务总局公告, 财税 notices). Query in Chinese. Returns, per document: title, document number (文号), issuing bodies, document date (成文日期), publisher validity flag (全文废止 / 已修改 when marked) and an id for cn_tax_policy_text. A query containing "2023年第39号" or the arguments year + number look a document up by its number directly. Covers tax policy only; for national laws and administrative regulations generally use cn_law.

query.description: Chinese keywords, e.g. "证券交易印花税 减半", or a document number such as "财政部 税务总局公告2023年第39号". Optional when year + number are given.

category.description: Document class filter: 法律 (law), 行政法规 (administrative regulation), 国务院文件, 税务部门规章 (departmental rule), 税务规范性文件 (STA normative document), 财税文件 (MOF/STA notice), 其他文件, 工作通知.

issuer.description: Document-series filter as it appears in the document number, e.g. "财政部税务总局公告", "国家税务总局公告", "财税", "国税发". Spaces are ignored.

year.description: Year in the document number, e.g. 2023.

number.description: Sequence number in the document number, e.g. 39.

limit.description: Results to return from the page, 1-10 (default 10; the source pages in tens).

tools.name: cn_tax_policy_text
tools.description: Full original Chinese text of one State Taxation Administration policy document from cn_tax_policy_search, with its title, document number (文号), document date, the effective date stated in the text when one is given, and the publisher validity flag. Pass the id returned by the search.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-china-tax-policy forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the china-tax-policy pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
